en.name: The One Ring
en.ability: A good player Bears the Ring. Each night*, the Ringbearer may pass the Ring to another living player. Players know if they bear the Ring. If the Demon bears, or a good Ringbearer dies, evil wins. If an evil Ringbearer dies, the Ring is passed to a good player.

revisions.v1: A good player Bears the Ring. Each night*, the Ringbearer may pass the Ring to another living player. Players know if they bear the Ring. If the Demon bears, or a good Ringbearer dies, evil wins. If an evil Ringbearer dies, the Ring is passed to a good player.

en.flavor:
One Ring to rule them all, One Ring to find them,

One Ring to bring them all...and in the darkness, bind them.
en.firstNightReminder: Inform the Ringbearer that they bear the Ring.
en.otherNightReminder: Ask the Ringbearer to pass the Ring. Inform the new Ringbearer.
